answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the crystal log shows the live set and the zenith audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 823 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Keeping 296 aliases alive therefore means 296 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the jade quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
